title: Ottoman Bows Broke World Flight Records
hook: Sultan Selim III shot an arrow 972 yards across an archery field.

scenes.text: To the Ottomans, archery was not merely a weapon of war—it was a sacred imperial art form practiced by Sultans and commoners alike.
